entities.summary: Nicocles was an Ancient Cyprian Greek king of Salamis, Cyprus. In 374/373 BC, he succeeded his (presumed) father Evagoras I. Nicocles continued the philhellenic politics of his father. Nicocles probably died together with Straton of Sidon during the revolt of satraps. He was followed as the king of Salamis by his son Evagoras II.
